32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Clean layout with deliberate Tol bright palette, but 5 of 9 cells render empty in the screenshot due to staggered animation timeouts, making the gallery look broken at first glance.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: Animation demo with correct zero baselines for all bar forms, no radius deception, but all domains are hardcoded (not data-driven), no key functions on joins, and the grouped→stacked transition uses a cumulative-sum domain [0,1.2] that can overflow with random data — structurally honest but brittle.
flags: Mid-Flight Snap: no .interrupt() guard before new transitions in loopMorph
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: Purely automated animation with no user-driven brush/zoom/mouse events eliminates most interaction stress-test concerns; the serial loopMorph callback chain prevents actual mid-flight conflicts, but the absence of .interrupt() leaves a theoretical gap if external code races with the transition.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9 simultaneous perpetual looping animations compete for attention by design, and 5 of 9 cells render blank in the screenshot (stagger delay likely exceeds screenshot capture timing), leaving more than half the gallery non-functional as presented.
